<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/gen_api.py. Edit docs/scripts/api_docs_en.py. -->

Services that talk to devices: boards on a serial port, MQTT brokers, WebSockets, UDP and TCP
sockets, Modbus PLCs and meters, Bluetooth LE gadgets and what answers on the local network.
They work like the [services](/pyzed/reference/services/): handlers go in `on_<event>=`, the
connection runs in a thread of its own and events reach the handlers on the app's thread. In
Pyzed Design they are the components of the IoT category. See the
[IoT guide](/pyzed/guides/iot/).

```python
board = pz.SerialPort(match="arduino", baud_rate=115200, on_line=self.reading)
board.connect()

mqtt = pz.MqttClient("broker.local", subscribe="home/#", on_message=self.received)
mqtt.connect()
mqtt.publish("home/lamp/set", "on")
```

Every connection has `connect()`, `disconnect()`, `connected`, `running` and the events
`connected`, `disconnected` and `failed`; with `reconnect` (milliseconds) it comes back by itself.

## Serial ports

### `SerialPort`

```python
class SerialPort
```

A serial or USB serial port (Arduino, ESP32, Pico, GPS...): `port` names it (`"COM3"`, `"/dev/ttyUSB0"`) or, empty, the first one `match` names (`"arduino"`, `"2341:0043"`; empty: the first USB port). Raises `data` (bytes) and `line` (text); `write()`, `send_line()`, `reset()` (DTR), `set_baud_rate()`. `SerialPort.ports(match)` lists the ports. Opens the device again when it comes back (`reconnect`, 1000 ms by default).

### `SerialWatcher`

```python
class SerialWatcher
```

Notices serial devices being plugged in and unplugged, every `interval` milliseconds: `plugged` and `unplugged` with a `PortInfo` (`name`, `kind`, `vid`, `pid`, `usb_id`, `manufacturer`, `product`, `description`), `change` with the list; `ports` is the last list.

## Messages and sockets

### `MqttClient`

```python
class MqttClient
```

An MQTT 3.1.1 client (Mosquitto, Home Assistant, EMQX...): `publish(topic, payload, qos, retain)`, `subscribe(topic)`, `unsubscribe()` and `on_topic(pattern, handler)` with the wildcards `+` and `#`. Each message raises `message` with an `MqttMessage` (`topic`, `payload`, `text`, `value`, `json()`); `last` keeps the last one of each topic. TLS, logins, QoS 0, 1 and 2, a last will, and the subscriptions kept after every reconnection (2000 ms by default).

### `WebSocket`

```python
class WebSocket
```

A WebSocket client (`ws://`, `wss://`): `send()` text, bytes or JSON; each message raises `message` (text, bytes or, with `json=True`, the parsed data). `headers`, `protocols`, a ping every `ping_interval` milliseconds.

### `UdpSocket`

```python
class UdpSocket
```

Sends and receives UDP datagrams: `start()` listens on `port`, each one raises `message` with a `UdpMessage` (`data`, `text`, `json()`, `host`, `port`); `send(data, host, port)`, `reply(message, data)`, `broadcast` and `multicast_group`.

### `TcpClient`

```python
class TcpClient
```

A TCP connection (optionally TLS) to a device or server: raises `data` and `line`; `write()` and `send_line()`.

## Industrial

### `ModbusClient`

```python
class ModbusClient
```

A Modbus client over TCP (`host`) or RTU (`serial_port`, RS-485): `read_coils`, `read_discrete_inputs`, `read_holding_registers`, `read_input_registers`, `read(table, address, format)` (`"float32"`, `"int32"`...), `write_coil`, `write_register`, `write_coils`, `write_registers` and `write(address, value, format)`. `poll` lines (`name table address [format] [count]`) are read every `interval` milliseconds and raise `update` with a dict. Raises `ModbusError` when the device refuses or does not answer.

## Discovery and Bluetooth

### `DeviceDiscovery`

```python
class DeviceDiscovery
```

Finds the devices of the local network with mDNS/Bonjour (`service`: `"_http._tcp"`, `"_esphomelib._tcp"`...; empty: all) and SSDP/UPnP: `scan()`, `start()`; raises `found` and `lost` with a `Device` (`name`, `host`, `port`, `address`, `kind`, `service`, `hostname`, `properties`, `url`), `change` and `done`. `pyzed.iot.resolve_local("esp32.local")` finds one address.

### `BluetoothScanner`

```python
class BluetoothScanner
```

Finds Bluetooth LE devices nearby for `timeout` milliseconds, filtered by `match` (name or address) and `services`: `scan()`, `start()`, `devices` (nearest first); raises `found` with a `BleDevice` (`address`, `name`, `rssi`, `uuids`, `manufacturer_data`), `change`, `done` and `failed`. Needs `pip install "pyzed-ui[bluetooth]"` (bleak).

### `BluetoothDevice`

```python
class BluetoothDevice
```

A connection to one Bluetooth LE device by `address` or `name`: `read(uuid)`, `write(uuid, data, response)`, `subscribe(uuid)`, `services()`; the characteristics in `notify` raise `notification` with a `BleNotification` (`uuid`, `data`, `text`, `value`). UUIDs can be short (`"2a37"`) or names (`"heart_rate_measurement"`, `"battery_level"`, `"nordic_uart_tx"`).
